new_insert_email_body.title: Urgent: London hotel with river views
new_insert_email_body.text:
Hi Emma,

The team needs a London hotel with confirmed views of the River Thames for the upcoming summit. Please pull up all London hotels, go through their reviews, and flag any that explicitly mention a River Thames view. Choose the hotel where the reviews most clearly highlight the view and reserve it for May 28–30, 2024.

This is urgent—the hotel must be confirmed before we can finalise the dinner arrangements.

Thanks,
Mark
